item.title: Daily Weather
item.description: Hello! Ready for today? Welcome to your weather report for Friday, October 9. It's Friday. The weekend is very nearly here! Looking outside in Shanghai, today will be cloudy. The high will be 25 degrees, and the low will be 16 degrees. Pleasantly warm today, perfect for being outdoors. Rain is about 22 percent likely today. Did you know today is day 282 of the year? There are 83 days to go until the new one. Look up at the clouds today. Can you find one shaped like an animal? Looking ahead to tomorrow, it will be drizzly, reaching 25 degrees. Think about teachers today. Would you like to know more about it? That's all from the weather desk. Enjoy your day!
